sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Healing Ability Power 60. Heals HP.
-Target: all allies. Applies beast (increases ATK and MATK by 60%; removes debuffs; removes status ailments; and applies a ward) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 40 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 10% Life Drain for 40 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 5000
[Additional Unison Effect] Applies 10% continuous healing to all allies for 40 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 5000
[Additional Unison Effect] Recovers 20 Cost for all allies.
